ThingDef.label: skulltop
ThingDef.description: An extremely deadly mushroom that steadily releases polluting toxic spores into the air. These spores rapidly produce toxic buildup in creatures not immune to poisons.

ThingDef.label: dewshrooms
ThingDef.description: Dewshrooms light up to attract small prey, which becomes trapped in their sticky gills.

ThingDef.label: mold fruiting bodies
ThingDef.description: The fruiting bodies of a mold that grows in caverns.

ThingDef.label: nuitae
ThingDef.description: While its cap's exterior is largely dark in color, its underside glows brightly. It grows most often in water or extremely wet environments.

ThingDef.label: nuitae
ThingDef.description: While its cap's exterior is largely dark in color, its underside glows brightly. It grows most often in water or extremely wet environments.

ThingDef.label: wrinklecap
ThingDef.description: A subterranean fungus that grows in damp environments. It is often eaten by fungivores.

ThingDef.label: wrinklecap
ThingDef.description: A subterranean fungus that grows in damp environments. It is often eaten by fungivores.

ThingDef.label: arpeau
ThingDef.description: Fast-growing, but doesn't yield much usable material. Aquatic fungus.

ThingDef.label: arpeau
ThingDef.description: Fast-growing, but doesn't yield much usable material. Aquatic fungus.

ThingDef.label: nogtyl
ThingDef.description: A strong wood-like mushroom. Fast-growing, but doesn't yield much usable material. It can only be grown by people on marshy soil.

ThingDef.label: nogtyl
ThingDef.description: A strong wood-like mushroom. Fast-growing, but doesn't yield much usable material. It can only be grown by people on marshy soil.

ThingDef.label: flakespire fungus
ThingDef.description: A strong purple mushroom tree. Slow-growing, but this woody fungus is very strong and attractive.

ThingDef.label: pusmelon
ThingDef.description: A green, gourd-like fungus that produces sacs of foul-smelling liquid.

ThingDef.label: rustpuff
ThingDef.description: A large puffball mushroom with flaky, rust-colored spores.

ThingDef.label: sagecrust
ThingDef.description: A tough, leafy lichen that can survive with minimal light.

ThingDef.label: bleeding tooth
ThingDef.description: A huge mushroom that secretes a red, blood-like fluid.

ThingDef.label: crimson cap
ThingDef.description: A large crimson-capped mushroom. It is pretty enough to be used for decor but not much else.

ThingDef.label: Grey Lady
ThingDef.description: A grey fungus that grows cloth-like lace from its cap.

ThingDef.label: shine cap
ThingDef.description: This large mushroom lives in symbiosis with a surprisingly tasty slime mold called Glimmerslime.

ThingDef.label: glimmerslime
ThingDef.description: Glimmerslime is a slime mold, not a real mushroom at all. It lives in symbiosis with the shinecaps.

ThingDef.label: shinebell
ThingDef.description: A small pretty mushroom that glows in the dark.

ThingDef.label: violet wimple
ThingDef.description: A big violet-capped mushroom. While not very productive, it does produce edible fungus.

ThingDef.label: mortal morel
ThingDef.description: A slow-growing mushroom which yields fungal medicine when harvested. Sowing and harvesting this fungus are both very labor-intensive because of its delicate structure.

ThingDef.label: mortal morel
ThingDef.description: A slow-growing mushroom which yields fungal medicine when harvested. Sowing and harvesting this fungus are both very labor-intensive because of its delicate structure.

ThingDef.label: fungal medicine
ThingDef.description: A pack of fungal concoctions extracted from the mortal morel. It is less potent than industrial pharmaceuticals, but much better than nothing.

ThingDef.label: moonless stripes
ThingDef.description: Heat-loving and durable, this bizarre fungus thrives in the depths of the earth. While it can be grown anywhere, it requires high heat to grow properly and no light at all. Its sturdy layered stalk can be used as a leathery textile.

ThingDef.label: moonless leather
ThingDef.description: Tanned, dried, scraped mushroom layers. A good underground material for making clothes and bags.

ThingDef.label: dulcis
ThingDef.description: An oddly sweet mushroom grown by cave dwellers in place of berries. It can survive in a wide range of temperatures and levels of pollution.

ThingDef.label: dulcis
ThingDef.description: Dulcis mushrooms. Nice to eat, even raw, if you like fungus.

ThingDef.label: blastpod shroom
ThingDef.description: A wild fungus prized for its dangerously volatile pods, which can be refined into chemfuel. It cannot be cultivated — at least not by Jawa.

ThingDef.label: blast spore sac
ThingDef.description: The spore sac of a blastpod fungus. It's a good fuel for campfires and generators, and can be refined into chemfuel.
